title: heze-devnet-1
announcements: heze-devnet-1 launched on the 6th of Oct 2026 (genesis 12:46 UTC, Heze at epoch 5).

**Scope change.** heze-devnet-1 is a **relaunch of [heze-devnet-0](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/heze-devnet-0)** after devnet-0 was accidentally killed. The spec scope is unchanged: [EIP-7805 FOCIL](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7805) on the **Heze** fork, same CL/EL spec PRs and test releases as devnet-0.
New spec work moves to [heze-devnet-2](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/heze-devnet-2), which adds 3 new CL EIPs on top of FOCIL: [EIP-8015](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8015), [EIP-8365](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8365) and [EIP-8198](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8198).
[bogota-devnet-0](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-0) (EIP-8141) is kept on a separate devnet track.
